IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: THE CENTER FOR HEALTH CARE STRATEGIES (CHCS) IS A POLICY DESIGN AND IMPLEMENTATION PARTNER DEVOTED TO IMPROVING OUTCOMES FOR PEOPLE ENROLLED IN MEDICAID. WE WORK ACROSS SECTORS AND DISCIPLINES TO MAKE MORE EFFECTIVE, EFFICIENT, AND EQUITABLE CARE POSSIBLE FOR MILLIONS OF PEOPLE IN THE U.S. WHO FACE SERIOUS BARRIERS TO WELLBEING, LIKE POVERTY, AND COMPLEX HEALTH AND SOCIAL NEEDS. FOR MORE THAN 30 YEARS CHCS HAS COLLABORATED WITH STATE MEDICAID AND RELATED HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES AGENCIES ACROSS THE COUNTRY TO SHAPE HOW HEALTH CARE SERVICES ARE DESIGNED, FINANCED, AND DELIVERED. FOUNDED IN 1995, CHCS RECEIVES RESOURCES FROM FEDERAL AND STATE AGENCIES, THE NATION'S LEADING HEALTH CARE FOUNDATIONS, AND CORPORATE PHILANTHROPIES COMMITTED TO INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS FOR PUBLICLY FINANCED CARE.
IRS990.MissionDesc: CHCS AIMS TO STRENGTHEN THE U.S. HEALTH CARE SYSTEM TO ENSURE BETTER, MORE EQUITABLE OUTCOMES, PARTICULARLY FOR PEOPLE SERVED BY MEDICAID. ITS WORK IS ORGANIZED UNDER THREE PRIORITIES: INTEGRATING SERVICES FOR PEOPLE WITH COMPLEX NEEDS, DELIVERY SYSTEM AND PAYMENT REFORM, AND LEADERSHIP AND CAPACITY BUILDING.
IRS990.Desc: INTEGRATING SERVICES FOR PEOPLE WITH COMPLEX NEEDS: CHCS SUPPORTS PRACTICAL AND COST-EFFECTIVE SOLUTIONS TO ENSURE THAT MEDICAID BENEFICIARIES WITH COMPLEX PHYSICAL, BEHAVIORAL, AND SOCIAL SERVICE NEEDS ARE SERVED BY PERSON-CENTERED SYSTEMS OF CARE. THROUGH DIRECT TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE, COLLABORATIVE LEARNING FORUMS, AND PILOT DEMONSTRATIONS, WE WORK WITH THE FEDERAL GOVERNMENT, MULTIPLE STATE AGENCIES, HEALTH PLANS, PROVIDERS, AND CONSUMER ORGANIZATIONS TO PROMOTE BETTER WAYS TO ORGANIZE, FINANCE, AND DELIVER CARE.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: DELIVERY SYSTEM AND PAYMENT REFORM: CHCS HELPS MEDICAID STAKEHOLDERS LEVERAGE THEIR PURCHASING POWER TO DRIVE IMPROVEMENTS IN HEALTH CARE ACCESS, QUALITY, AND COST EFFECTIVENESS. WE SUPPORT STATES, HEALTH PLANS, ACCOUNTABLE CARE ORGANIZATIONS AND OTHERS IN DESIGNING AND IMPLEMENTING COMPREHENSIVE, STATEWIDE MULTI-PAYER DELIVERY SYSTEM AND PAYMENT REFORMS THAT REWARD QUALITY AND SEEK TO IMPROVE POPULATION HEALTH.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: LEADERSHIP AND CAPACITY BUILDING: MEDICAID PLAYS A CRITICAL ROLE IN THE U.S HEALTH CARE SYSTEM BY EXPANDING ACCESS TO APPROPRIATE SERVICES, IMPROVING HEALTH CARE QUALITY, AND CONTROLLING COSTS. CHCS BUILDS THE CAPACITY OF STATE MEDICAID DIRECTORS AND OTHER KEY STAKEHOLDERS TO EFFECTIVELY MANAGE AND PURSUE INNOVATIONS THAT CAN HELP LEAD THE NATION TOWARD A BETTER HEALTH CARE SYSTEM.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE PROGRAMMATIC ACTIVITIES SUPPORTED WITH REGRANTS ARE AN ESSENTIAL COMPONENT OF THE OVERALL PROJECTS AND ARE CRITICAL TO CHCS' ABILITY TO MEET ITS BROADER DELIVERABLES, WHICH INCLUDE THE IDENTIFICATION OF BEST PRACTICES THAT CAN BE BROADLY REPLICATED ACROSS STATES. IN TERMS OF THE REGRANTING PROCESS, TO ENSURE GOOD STEWARDSHIP, CHCS EITHER ESTABLISHES AN EXTERNAL REVIEW COMMITTEE OR ENGAGES EXTERNAL PARTNERS TO SUPPORT REVIEW OF SUBMITTED PROPOSALS FROM PROSPECTIVE PARTICIPANTS, AND TO RECOMMEND SITES FOR SELECTION AND RECEIPT OF THE RE-GRANTS. IN ADDITION TO THE REGRANTED FUNDS, CHCS: (1) PROVIDES TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE TO FURTHER SUPPORT PROGRAM ACTIVITIES, (2) SUPPORTS PEER LEARNING OPPORTUNITIES WITH OTHER SITES IN THE PROJECT, AND (3) DISTILLS INSIGHTS FROM THE SITES' EXPERIENCES INTO REPORTS AND OTHER PUBLICATIONS FOR THE PURPOSE OF SHARING LESSONS BROADLY WITH THE FIELD. COLLECTIVELY, THESE EFFORTS REFLECT CHCS' SCOPE OF WORK WITH THE ORIGINAL FUNDER.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION HAS ITS FORM 990 PREPARED BY AN OUTSIDE ACCOUNTING FIRM AND HAS ESTABLISHED THE FOLLOWING REVIEW PROCESS TO ENSURE THAT THE INFORMATION REPORTED IS COMPLETE AND ACCURATE. AFTER THE FORM 990 HAS BEEN PREPARED, A COPY IS REVIEWED BY MANAGEMENT AND WHEN IT IS READY TO BE FILED WITH THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE, IT IS ELECTRONICALLY SENT TO THE BOARD FOR REVIEW. MEMBERS ARE INVITED TO CONTACT MANAGEMENT WITH ANY RECOMMENDED CHANGES VIA EMAIL OR PHONE. ONCE THE BOARD HAS REVIEWED THE RETURN IT IS FILED WITH THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EACH EMPLOYEE AND MEMBER OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES IS REQUIRED TO COMPLETE A CONFLICT OF INTEREST DISCLOSURE ON AN ANNUAL BASIS. THE VICE PRESIDENT OF HUMAN RESOURCES AND SENIOR GRANTS AND CONTRACTS MANAGER REVIEW THE AGREEMENTS AND REPORT ANY CONCERNS TO THE PRESIDENT AND CEO. DEPENDING UPON THE NATURE OF THE CONFLICT, THIS MAY INCLUDE THE EMPLOYEE OR BOARD MEMBER RECUSING THEMSELVES FROM A POSITION OF DECISION-MAKING AUTHORITY WITH RESPECT TO THE CONFLICT SITUATION OR OTHER MORE SERIOUS ACTIONS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE COMPENSATION PACKAGE FOR THE PRESIDENT AND CEO IS REVIEWED ANNUALLY BY THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES. THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE MAKES A RECOMMENDATION TO THE FULL BOARD OF TRUSTEES FOR APPROVAL. THE APPROVAL IS OFFICIALLY DOCUMENTED IN THE MINUTES, AND THE BOARD CHAIR ISSUES A LETTER TO THE CEO FOR ORGANIZATIONAL FILES. THE VICE PRESIDENT OF HUMAN RESOURCES OVERSEES THE PROCESS. COMPENSATION FOR ALL OTHER OFFICERS AND KEY EMPLOYEES IS DETERMINED BY USING MARKET COMPENSATION ANALYSIS (UPDATED EVERY THREE YEARS) AND APPROVED ANNUALLY BY THE PRESIDENT AND CEO.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS FORM 990 AVAILABLE FOR PUBLIC INSPECTION AS REQUIRED UNDER SECTION 6104 OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE. THE RETURN IS ALSO POSTED ON GUIDESTAR.ORG AND OTHER SIMILAR TYPES OF WEBSITES. IN ADDITION, THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, ARTICLES OF INCORPORATION AND BY-LAWS ARE ALSO AVAILABLE UPON WRITTEN REQUEST OR BY CALLING THE ORGANIZATION DIRECTLY.
